assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE cohesive production near-background environmental assembly, genuinely TRANSPARENT outside the assembly and through its large negative spaces. Not a prop atlas. No repeated miniatures. For an illustrated dark metroidvania, straight-on 2D side elevation. Chunky soft painted material texture matching the provided reference terrain, restrained fine detail, subdued matte lighting, NO photorealism, no thin scratches, no pixel art, no text, no characters, no UI, no playable floors, no rectangular scenery background. Large irregular silhouette and purposeful negative spaces; diffuse mid-dark values, no bright highlights. Reference is material/style ONLY: do not copy its repeated wall pattern or level geometry. Requested portrait 1536x3072, aspect 1:2. A gigantic continuous interior hollow-tree support spanning three stories. Muted walnut brown. ONE uninterrupted sinuous living trunk runs from thick roots at the base to the top. At uneven heights it splits into three broad branches that extend sideways, one truncated hollow branch opening in the middle, and a small empty paper-strip nest tucked near the top. Leave broad transparent windows between the asymmetric branches. The lower trunk bends left, middle bends right, upper splits left again: continuous organic vertical motion, not a stack of stump props. Fully contain all painted content with 5% transparent margin. No detached fragments. Designed for a 22-cell wide and 46-cell high tower.
